contract_design.single_source: workerResponseFields(delivery) is the ordered 12-field descriptor list used both by parseWorkerResponse and by workerResponseContract. The parser requires the exact descriptor order, types, immutable values and stage-specific decision enum; marker is the same constant used in the injected contract.
contract_design.injection: Only worker task/execute or question/analysis with positive safe revision receives response_contract beside the original payload. It includes marker, compact-frame format, ordered fields, immutable task/revision/run/message/attempt/session values, decision enum, canonical UUID response_id generation, and explicit one-frame/no-prose/no-tools/no-thinking/no-extra-content instructions.
contract_design.provider: The one scripted worker provider shared by both actual OMP probes reads response_contract from the delivered user message, validates its machine rules and descriptor grammar, and builds the frame in contract field_order using descriptor values. It has no hardcoded marker, 12-field response literal, or outer-message identity construction. Missing/malformed contract yields invalid rather than valid control output.
